name: e2e
summary: End-to-end tests: Playwright drives the built client in a real browser, on the simulator and against the real server, through page objects.

scripts.e2e:install: pnpm --dir packages/e2e exec playwright install chromium

notes: The add-on's AGENTS.md section names its example specs by their templates in `tools/templates/`, which every project with the add-on has, not by their place in `packages/e2e/src`. A project that replaced the examples, as one whose app is not the starter's does, failed the kit's `agent-docs` gate on three lines of the section.
